claims.claim: Consolidated Water's Q2 update disclosed a 25-year exclusive Grand Cayman concession, commissioning of a second Cat Island desalination plant, a limited notice to proceed on the $204M Kalaeloa Hawaii desalination project, and $10.1M of Florida municipal equipment orders after quarter end, expanding visible project optionality beyond its legacy Caribbean operations.

risks.risk: Large project opportunities can have long development cycles and limited notices to proceed do not equal full project revenue authorization.

unknowns.unknown: Timing and margin contribution of the full Kalaeloa project remain contingent on subsequent authorization and execution.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 total revenue decreased 2% to $32.9M while bulk revenue increased 20% to $9.9M; the company ended June with substantial liquidity, creating a mixed execution picture of flat/down consolidated top line but improving bulk activity and project runway.

risks.risk: Current consolidated revenue contraction shows project awards have not yet translated into broad top-line acceleration.

unknowns.unknown: No post-Q2 issuer financial update was found in this bounded Scout pass.
